Descriptions

Say goodbye to scooping forever and enjoy a cleaner, smarter cat-care experience with the Meowant SC09 Plus Automatic Litter Box!

Extra Large Space & Low Entry Design:
Upgraded from Meowant SC02 to SC09 Plus, this automatic litter box features an extra-large 106L spacious toilet area with an open design, allowing cats to move freely and comfortably. Suitable for all kinds of cats and multi-cat households, supporting cats weighing 3.3–30 lbs. The 8.27-inch low entrance is friendly for short-legged, overweight, and senior cats. For multi-cat families, SC09 Plus is all you need.

Anti-Pinch Protection & Safety Sensors:
Designed with an integrated rotating structure for the litter bin and drum, the semi-gear mechanism ensures the opening always faces outward, eliminating the risk of pinching or trapping cats. Equipped with multiple high-precision sensors for weight detection, motion interruption, and abnormal alarms, ensuring 100% cat safety at all times.

Upgraded Liner & Dual Odor Control:
The upgraded double-layer silicone liner features a seamless edge design, reducing leakage by up to 50%. It is waterproof, non-stick, scratch-resistant, durable, and easy to clean. Combined with a physical odor-proof cover and a deodorizing gel that breaks down ammonia, it keeps the litter box environment fresh and hygienic.

APP Control & Health Monitoring:
Supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi only. With the AIRPET APP, you can remotely monitor litter box usage, control cleaning modes, and view real-time data. After the APP upgrade, it can record usage data for 30+ cats, track weight changes, and monitor activity levels to help detect potential health issues early.

Multiple Self-Cleaning Modes & Universal Litter Compatibility:

products.title: Meowant Automatic Wet Food Cat Feeder-MW-PF06
products.body_html:
Semiconductor Cooling & Pre-Heating

Unlike ordinary wet food feeders that rely on ice packs or only cool from the bottom, our wet cat food feeder uses semiconductor cooling and heating technology to maintain an even temperature from all sides. The advanced cooling system keeps food at around 40°F, while the feeder automatically pre-heats the food to your cat's preferred serving temperature 30 minutes before the lid opens. This helps make meals more enjoyable and easier to digest.

Programmable Timer & Independent Temperature Control

Set separate opening and closing times for each of the two stainless steel bowls, with up to 2 meals per day and precise portion control. Each bowl has its own temperature control, so you can set both bowls to open at the same time for two cats to eat together, or open them at different times to fit your feeding schedule. The lid automatically closes 1 hour after opening to help keep food fresh. Ideal for homes with 1–2 cats.

Voice Call for Timely Feeding

Record a 10-second voice message, and the feeder will play it automatically every time the lid opens. Hearing your familiar voice can help comfort your cat and reduce stress when you're away. It also lets your cat know that food is ready, encouraging them to eat on time instead of missing a meal. This feature is especially helpful for shy or easily distracted cats that may not notice the lid opening.

Food-Grade Stainless Steel Bowls, Dishwasher Safe

Made with food-grade stainless steel, the non-porous bowls resist odors and are easy to clean. They also help reduce the risk of chin acne in cats with sensitive skin. Each 350ML bowl is 1.29 inches deep, with a shallow design that helps reduce whisker contact for a more comfortable eating experience. The feeder comes with 2 removable, dishwasher-safe bowls, making it easy to prepare separate meals or feed two cats.(Note: The main unit is not washable. Wipe it with a soft, damp cloth only.)

Safety First

Our Meowant wet food feeder is ETL certified and features an anti-pinch lid design to help protect your cat's paws and head from accidental pinching. A built-in backup capacitor allows the lid to automatically open during a power outage, helping make sure your cat does not miss a meal during an unexpected blackout. The feeder also comes with a 1-year product warranty and a 2-year motor warranty for added peace of mind.

products.title: Meowant Sensor Mode Clean & Waste Water Separation Fountain-DF03
products.body_html:
Fresh Water, Ready When They Need It

With our upgraded Sensor Mode, your cat gets a fresh supply of water just 15 minutes after drinking. While other fountains may take an hour or longer, our faster refresh cycle keeps water fresher with less waiting. A great choice for busy households and cats with sensitive needs.

Smart Automatic Sensor

The fountain detects when your cat approaches and automatically dispenses fresh water when needed. This feature works when Sensor Mode is enabled and the stainless steel bowl is empty, helping reduce unnecessary water consumption and extend battery life.

Separate Clean & Dirty Water. No Filter Required.

Clean water and wastewater are kept in separate tanks, preventing them from mixing and eliminating the need for replacement filters. That means you can save at least $120 per year on filter costs while keeping your cat's drinking water cleaner and fresher.
Clean water tank: 4.5L | Wastewater tank: 2.1L

Safe, Shock-Free Design

Water and electronic components are completely separated. The electrical components are positioned above the water, preventing water from coming into contact with the power source. This helps provide a safer drinking experience for your pet while also protecting the fountain's internal components.

Timed Water Refresh

Choose between automatic refresh intervals of every 4 or 6 hours. The fountain regularly replaces the water with fresh water, helping maintain a cleaner and more consistent drinking environment throughout the day.

Long-Lasting Battery. No Wires, No Limits.

Equipped with a 2000mAh USB-C rechargeable battery, the fountain can run for up to 19 days on a single charge, making it convenient for travel, weekends away, or everyday use without being tied to a power outlet.
Battery life varies depending on the operating mode.
